chunks: Do not marvel at their wealth and children. God intends to punish them through these in the world; and their souls will depart in a state of disbelief.
ai.seo_question: Why does God allow disbelievers to prosper in this world?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of 'Istidraj' (gradual divine ensnarement), where material abundance serves as a temporary trial rather than a sign of divine favor. It underscores the spiritual peril of remaining in disbelief despite outward blessings, emphasizing that true success lies in the purification of the soul before death. This perspective encourages believers to view worldly prosperity with detachment, recognizing it as a potential mechanism for spiritual loss if it fosters arrogance or neglect of faith.
